plugins.name: repo-aware-hiring
plugins.description: Hiring for software engineers, grounded in your codebase: maps the code first (one repo or many), drafts job descriptions, screens CVs with quote-verified evidence for a qualified person to review, and prepares structured interview kits. Decision support only: it never rejects anyone.
